en.io: Input: an internal-operations request and optional local artifacts. Output: selected sub-skill invocation, at most one clarifying question when ambiguous, and a short digest with findings, actions, artifact paths, and one challenge.
en.boundary: Routes to exactly one primary lane at a time and does not itself perform specialist analysis. Mixed lanes require explicit follow-up before a second route. The manifest evidence does not include the referenced vendor-management skill content.
dependencies: Six sibling skills: process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer

scenarios: Choose the correct skill for a BizOps review.
Route a mixed vendor-SLA and spend question in stages.
Keep heavy operational intake in a forked context.
